record.question:
Under the Indian constitutional architecture, the President of India is bound by the advice of the
    Council of Ministers. However, the President possesses situational discretion in which of the following
    scenarios?
      1. Appointment of the Prime Minister when no single party or coalition commands a clear majority
          in the Lok Sabha.
      2. Dismissal of the Council of Ministers when it has lost the confidence of the Lok Sabha but
          refuses to resign.
      3. Dissolution of the Lok Sabha if the Council of Ministers has lost its majority and lacks support
          to form an alternative stable government.
